architecture_record.substantive_difference: bounded local causal attention plus explicitly routed global information, grouped-query key/value sharing and a measured cache footprint
architecture_record.position_representation: RoPE applied to attention queries and keys
architecture_record.tokenizer: new 25k byte-level BPE trained on the selected official training split only; RoPE is positional encoding
architecture_record.student_model_config: 14 pre-RMSNorm decoder blocks, width 512, 8 query/2 KV heads, head width 64, SwiGLU width 1536, tied 25k token embeddings, RoPE, local window 256 plus every-128th causal global anchor, maximum 1536 positions
architecture_record.student_exact_parameter_derivation: For V=25000: embedding V*512=12,800,000; each block attention=656,640, SwiGLU=2,362,880, two RMSNorms=1,024, so 14*3,020,544=42,287,616; final norm=512 and output bias=25,000; total=55,113,128 trainable parameters. Recompute with the actual BPE size.
architecture_record.student_design_rationale: A 14-layer 55.1M-parameter model balances depth against T4 throughput; grouped-query sharing reduces KV cache by 4x versus 8 KV heads; local/global causal visibility retains nearby detail and sparse long-range anchors. SDPA runs full-sequence attention efficiently; bounded KV cache accelerates autoregressive generation. This AI-assisted design must be disclosed, not attested as independently student-authored.
architecture_record.authorship_disclosure: AI-assisted architecture and implementation; student-owned attestation remains false pending course-approved independent revision

innovation_hypothesis: At equal legal-token budget and 25k BPE, 14-layer causal local/global GQA with RoPE may improve continuation loss or tokens/second relative to the earlier encoder-decoder and prefix-hybrid runs; report measured quality and runtime rather than assume a gain.
ablation_control: Compare Submission 03 prefix-hybrid and Submission 02 encoder-decoder only where corpus subset, tokenizer, target words, checkpoint-selection protocol, and actual trained-token counts are documented; otherwise label the comparison observational, not matched.
